instruction: Write a precise English editing instruction for single-person pose transfer. <image1> is the source photograph: retain its person identity, face, hairstyle, glasses, clothing design, colors, material, accessories, shoes and photographic scene. <image2> is the target photograph: use ONLY its body action, head orientation, observable hand configuration and facial expression. Never copy its identity, hair, clothes, jewelry, colors, background or objects. <image3> is a DWPose-style 2D projection of an estimated 3D SMPL-X body, already scaled and positioned for the source canvas; black regions are not a scene. Use this guide for the visible body joint arrangement. B RGB may clarify head direction and hands when the estimated guide is inaccurate; do not invent invisible details. The task transfers pose ONLY. The target basketball must NOT appear. Describe the raised/turned hand and its orientation. Do not introduce any target-only object or a replacement for it. Preserve objects already in the source; if the source has no held objects, keep the transferred hand empty. Organize the rewritten instruction around source appearance preservation, explicit target body/head/hand action, skeletal reference, original photographic style, and the actual edit. Avoid guessing ethnicity, age, brands or hidden anatomy. Describe arm and hand placement using viewer image-left/image-right only; do not assign anatomical left/right labels, which can conflict with image directions. Do not enumerate the target clothes or other target appearance in negative clauses; preserve source appearance without bringing those target details into the instruction. The downstream editor receives ONLY the source and skeleton, so state the desired action explicitly in words. In rewritten_prompt, refer to the source as <image1> and the skeleton as <image3>; do NOT refer to the target photograph as <image2>. Do not render skeleton lines or their colors. Keep the source setting and overall illumination, allowing natural cloth folds and pose-dependent shadows. Return the official JSON contract with rewritten_prompt, wh_ratio="", ratio_follow="<image1>". Do not change the canvas or introduce a new style.
